Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ъяснить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to explain', paired with 'объяснять'.

examples.trans: I will explain everything to you right now.

meanings.note: неё = genitive after a preposition (у неё), ней = instrumental after a preposition (с ней)

meanings.note: Prefix 'пере-' denotes crossing over, repeating, or exceeding a limit (stem 'путать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to mix up, to confuse', paired with 'путать'.
